package samples

data class Reading<T>(val tag: String, val value: T?)

/* A comment /* with a nested note */
   continues here. */
fun labels(items: List<Reading<Int>>): List<String> =
    items.mapIndexed { index, item ->
        val display = item.value?.let { it * 2 } ?: 0
        val summary = """
            reading $index
            ${item.tag}: $display
        """.trimIndent()
        summary
    }

fun main() {
    val first = Reading("café", 42)
    println(labels(listOf(first)).joinToString("\n"))
}
